property_identity.name: The Interstitial Travel Bureau
property_identity.premise: An official traveler-safety network for impossible interstellar and interdimensional destinations.

visual_invariants: 1960s instructional-film composition interpreted through an imagined 1980s future
moderate readable film and VHS wear that never obscures safety information
specific physical materials and spatial behavior in every world image

restrained educational electronics and tape texture
warnings use polite two-tone institutional chimes
